source.title: Signets of the Lost Temple
source.objective:
ProgressFor de most powerful adventurer, I offer de most powerful trades. I have somethin' that enhances your shoulder items, power from de Atal'ai themselves! <name>, if you have mojo found by the strongest of dere Atal'ai in da temple, I will make it worth your while.

Let's not be too hasty now, I offer da fairest deals...
source.completion: Be goin' now, mon. If ya need more of da goods, you know where to find me, <name>!
